This script is the primary analysis for an academic manuscript: "DNA metabarcoding reveals prey diversity and structure in the diet of gray whales."

Authors for this paper:

- Charles Nye*
- Leigh Torres
- Alejandro Fernandez Ajo
- Natalie Chazal
- Lisa Hildebrand
- Hali Peterson
- Sarah Henkel
- Debbie Steel
- C. Scott Baker

Charles Nye is the corresponding author: charles.nye@oregonstate.edu

In order to properly run this script, curated raw data inputs from Dryad repository (X) are required. This .qmd file assumes the data inputs reside within a sister directory (titled "00_data-inputs").

```{r Setup}
#| echo: false
# Set seed #
set.seed(120396)
# This function just clears everything out, for those who come after #
gommage = function() {
  gctorture(TRUE)
  rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE, envir = sys.frame(-1)),
     envir = sys.frame(-1))
  while (dev.cur() > 1) {
    dev.off()
  }
  gctorture(FALSE)
}

# Import packages #
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  ANCOMBC, data.table, factoextra, ggpubr, ggrepel, ggtext, ggvenn, glue, indicspecies,
  kableExtra, knitr, pacman, tidyverse, vegan, viridis, webshot2, scales, patchwork, gt,
  cluster, fpc, corrplot, FSAmisc, hexbin, sf, marmap, rnaturalearth, ggspatial, ggnewscale,
  shadowtext
)
# Warning: some of these packages are from bioconductor and, therefore, may require some additional TLC to get installed and working. #
```

```{r Import data}
#| echo: false
read.data = function(x) {
  read.csv(paste0("../00_data-inputs/", x, ".csv"), row.names = 1, header = TRUE)
}

read.data("read_table") -> raw.reads # Read table #
read.data("blast_table") -> blast # BLAST outputs #
read.data("taxonomy_table") -> taxonomy # Taxonomy table #
read.data("metadata") -> metadata # Metadata table #

# Specific metadata subsets #
sample.metadata = metadata %>% filter(type == "dDNA_E.robustus")
control.metadata = metadata %>% filter(type != "dDNA_E.robustus")
# Sample lists #
metadata %>% filter(type == "dDNA_E.robustus") %>% pull(sample) %>% unique() -> gw.dDNA.samples
```

## DUPLICATES

```{r Take the average, keep only 1}
#| echo: false
# Handle duplicates #
metadata %>% distinct(sample, full_id) %>%
  group_by(full_id) %>%
  mutate(reps = n_distinct(sample)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(reps > 1) %>%
  pull(sample) %>% c() -> dups
dups # These are the samples
metadata %>% distinct(sample, full_id) %>%
  group_by(full_id) %>%
  mutate(reps = n_distinct(sample)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(reps > 1) %>% distinct(sample, full_id) %>%
  group_by(full_id) %>% slice_head(n = 1) %>% ungroup() -> dup.meta

raw.reads %>% filter(sample %in% dups) %>%
  left_join(., (metadata %>% distinct(sample, full_id)), by = "sample") %>%
  group_by(full_id, ASV_ID) %>%
  summarise(RA = mean(RA)) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(RA = floor(RA)) %>%
  left_join(., (raw.reads %>% dplyr::select(ASV_ID, MOTU) %>% unique()),
             by = "ASV_ID") -> dup.reads
dup.reads %>% left_join(., dup.meta, by = "full_id") %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, everything()) %>% dplyr::select(-full_id) -> dup.reads

raw.reads %>% filter(!sample %in% dups) -> reads
rbind(raw.reads, dup.reads) %>% arrange(sample) -> raw.reads

metadata %>% filter(sample %in% raw.reads$sample) -> metadata

# Tidy up #
remove(dups)
remove(dup.meta)
remove(dup.reads)
```

## SEQ OUTPUT & ASV CONVERSION TO MOTUS

```{r Read QC}

#### Descriptive components ####
# Initial n #
raw.reads %>% filter(sample %in% gw.dDNA.samples) %>%
  pull(sample) %>% unique() %>% length() -> initial.n
initial.n

# Pre-QC read abundance (total) #
raw.reads$RA %>% sum() %>% comma() -> preQC.RA
preQC.RA

# Pre-QC read abundance (mean) #
raw.reads %>% group_by(sample) %>% summarise(RA = sum(RA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% pull(RA) %>% mean() %>% signif(digits = 3) %>%
  comma() -> preQC.mean.RA
preQC.mean.RA

# Pre-QC ASV richness #
(length(unique(raw.reads$ASV_ID))+183) %>% comma() -> preQC.ASV.S # Add 183 that had no matches
preQC.ASV.S

# Gray whale ASVs #
taxonomy %>% filter(family == "Eschrichtiidae") %>% pull(ASV_ID) %>%
  unique() -> gw.ASVs
gw.ASVs %>% length()

# Mean GW ASV RA (per-sample) #
raw.reads %>% filter(ASV_ID %in% gw.ASVs) %>% group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(RA = mean(RA)) %>% ungroup() %>% pull(RA) %>% mean() %>%
  comma() -> gw.ASV.RA.mean
gw.ASV.RA.mean

# Mean GW ASV RA (total) #
raw.reads %>% filter(ASV_ID %in% gw.ASVs) %>% pull(RA) %>% sum() %>%
  comma() -> gw.ASV.RA.total
gw.ASV.RA.total

# Percentage #
((raw.reads %>% filter(ASV_ID %in% gw.ASVs) %>% pull(RA) %>% sum())/sum(raw.reads$RA)*100) %>% signif(digits = 3) -> gw.ASV.RA.percentage
gw.ASV.RA.percentage

#### QC ####
# Select gray whale dDNA samples #
raw.reads %>% filter(sample %in% gw.dDNA.samples) -> reads
#### Filter gray whale reads ####
reads %>% filter(!ASV_ID %in% gw.ASVs) -> reads
#### Remove samples under QC threshold ####
blast %>% filter(percent_identity >= 85.0 | bit_score >= 250.0) %>%
  pull(ASV_ID) %>% unique() -> quality.ASVs
blast %>% filter(percent_identity < 85.0 | bit_score < 250.0) %>%
  unique() -> ASVs.below.threshold
reads %>% filter(ASV_ID %in% quality.ASVs) -> reads
#### Contaminants ####
taxonomy %>% filter(kingdom == "Fungi" | # Not mushroom to discuss
                 kingdom == "Bacteria" | # 5 second rule, much?
                 kingdom == "Bacillati" | # I'd hate to be a microbiome researcher; how many taxa are there???
                 kingdom == "Heunggongvirae" | # Are viruses life?
                 kingdom == "Pseudomonadati" | # Pseudo-what-i?
                 class == "Insecta" | # This bugs me.
                 class == "Hexapoda" | # Ditto.
                 class == "Protura" | # Trio.
                 class == "Arachnida" | # I like spiders, though.
                 MOTU == "Channa gachua" | # Weird freshwater fish.
                 class == "Mammalia" | # With apologies to my beloved pets, but I don't want dog or cat DNA in here.
                 order == "Primates" |
                 species == "Bacteriophage sp.") -> contaminant.ASVs 
reads %>% filter(!ASV_ID %in% contaminant.ASVs$ASV_ID) -> reads
#### Remove singletons ####
reads %>% group_by(ASV_ID) %>% summarise(RA = sum(RA)) %>%
  filter(RA <= 1) %>% pull(ASV_ID) %>% unique() -> singleton.ASVs
reads %>% filter(!ASV_ID %in% singleton.ASVs) -> reads
# Remove useless MOTUs #
reads %>% filter(MOTU != "uncultured diatom" &
              MOTU != "uncultured dinoflagellate" &
              MOTU != "uncultured Kareniaceae" &
              MOTU != "invertebrate environmental sample") -> reads
# High-res reads only #
reads %>% filter(MOTU %in% (taxonomy %>% filter(MOTU_level == "species" | MOTU_level == "genus" | MOTU_level == "family") %>% pull(MOTU) %>% unique())) -> reads

#### Evaluate post-QC reads ####
reads$RA %>% sum() %>% comma() -> postQC.RA
postQC.RA

reads %>% group_by(sample) %>% summarise(RA = sum(RA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% pull(RA) %>% mean() %>% signif(digits = 3) %>%
  comma()  -> postQC.mean.RA
postQC.mean.RA

(length(unique(reads$ASV_ID))) %>% comma() -> postQC.ASV.S
postQC.ASV.S

#### Archive ####
MOTU.ASV.archive = reads %>% group_by(MOTU) %>%
  summarise(constituent.ASVs = paste(ASV_ID, collapse = ", "))
reads -> reads.archive
# Master contaminant table with reasons for removal #
gw.ASVs %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::rename("ASV_ID" = 1) %>%
  mutate(dropped_cause = "Gray whale ASV") -> x
contaminant.ASVs %>% distinct(ASV_ID) %>% mutate(dropped_cause = "Contaminant") -> y
raw.reads %>% distinct(ASV_ID) %>%
  filter(!ASV_ID %in% x$ASV_ID & !ASV_ID %in% y$ASV_ID & !ASV_ID %in% reads$ASV_ID) %>%
  mutate(dropped_cause = "Below QC Threshold") -> z

rbind(x, y, z) %>% left_join(., blast, by = "ASV_ID",
                             relationship = "many-to-many") -> dropped_ASVs
dropped_ASVs %>% dplyr::select(ASV_ID, dropped_cause,
                               MOTU, MOTU_level, db_source,
                               taxonomy_query, accession, NCBI_taxID,
                               percent_identity, e_value, bit_score) -> TableS1
kable(TableS1) %>% kable_minimal() # Supplementary Table 1
```

A number of ASVs were omitted ahead of proper analysis.

## SEAWATER CONTROLS COMPARISON

```{r Seawater controls}
control.df = left_join(control.metadata, raw.reads, by = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::select(-MOTU) %>%
  left_join(taxonomy, by = "ASV_ID", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, ASV_ID, MOTU, MOTU_level, type, RA, diet_item)

raw.reads %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample") %>%
  filter(type == "dDNA_E.robustus") %>%
  dplyr::select(-MOTU) %>%
  left_join(taxonomy, by = "ASV_ID", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, ASV_ID, MOTU, MOTU_level, type, RA, diet_item) %>%
  rbind(control.df) %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    type == "prey_positive" ~ "Prey Sample",
    type == "field_negative" ~ "eDNA",
    type == "PCR_negative" ~ "PCR Negative",
    type == "dDNA_E.robustus" ~ "dDNA",
    TRUE ~ type
  )) -> control.df

control.df %>%
  mutate(diet_item = case_when(
    MOTU %in% c("Eschrichtiidae", "Eschrichtius robustus") ~ "Gray Whale",
    TRUE ~ diet_item
  )) %>%
  filter(type != "Prey Sample") -> control.df

control.df %>%
  filter(!is.na(diet_item)) %>%
  group_by(type, diet_item) %>%
  summarise(RA = sum(RA), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = type, y = RA, fill = diet_item)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black", width = 0.66) +

fig.A1 # Appendix fig. 1

  filter(type == "eDNA") %>%
  distinct(ASV_ID, MOTU) -> eDNA.ASVs

control.df %>%
  filter(type == "dDNA") %>%
  distinct(ASV_ID, MOTU) -> dDNA.ASVs

setdiff(eDNA.ASVs, dDNA.ASVs) %>%
  left_join(.,
  (blast %>% distinct(ASV_ID, sequence, MOTU_level,
   db_source, taxonomy_query, accession,
   NCBI_taxID, percent_identity, e_value, bit_score)), by = "ASV_ID") -> TableS2
kable(TableS2) %>% kable_minimal()

#### Do an ordination ####
control.df %>% group_by(ASV_ID) %>%
  summarise(RA = sum(RA)) %>% arrange(RA) %>%
  filter(!ASV_ID %in% contaminant.ASVs$ASV_ID) %>% # Remove contaminants
  pull(ASV_ID) -> ASVs_to_ordinate
control.df %>% group_by(sample) %>%
 summarise(RA = sum(RA)) %>% arrange(RA) %>% 
 filter(RA >= 100) %>% # Let's omit samples under 100 reads
  pull(sample) -> samples_to_ordinate
control.df %>% filter(ASV_ID %in% ASVs_to_ordinate &
                      sample %in% samples_to_ordinate) -> control.df
control.df %>% distinct(sample, type) -> ordination.meta
control.df %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, ASV_ID, RA) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "ASV_ID", values_from = "RA", values_fn = sum) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "sample") %>%
  mutate(across(1:ncol(.), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) -> ASV.comm
ASV.comm %>% decostand(method = "rclr") %>%
  vegdist(., method = "euclidean") %>% cmdscale(eig = TRUE) -> ASV.pcoa
ASV.pcoa$eig %>% data.frame() %>% filter(. > 0) %>% sum() -> x
(ASV.pcoa$eig[1] / x)*100
(ASV.pcoa$eig[2] / x)*100

ASV.pcoa$points %>% data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample") %>% dplyr::rename("PCo1" = "X1",
                                                       "PCo2" = "X2") %>%
  left_join(., ordination.meta, by = "sample") %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(x = PCo1, y = PCo2, color = type, shape = type), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#E69F00", "#006299", "#E41A1C")) +
  labs(
    title = "A.",
    #subtitle = bquote("PERMANOVA R"^2 ~ "= 0.34"),
    x = "PCo1 (68.7 % variance explained)",
    y = "PCo2 (22.7% variance explained)", color = "Sample Type",
    shape = "Sample Type") +
    theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(color = "black")) -> Fig.S1
Fig.S1
```

# Establishing RA Cutoff

```{r Read abundance exploratory figures}
#| echo: false
reads %>% group_by(sample) %>% summarise(RA = sum(RA)) %>% ungroup() -> test.reads
test.reads %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = RA)) + geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "#006299") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 7202, linetype = "dashed", color = "#E69F00", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_bw() + labs(x = "RA", y = "Count", title = "A",
                    caption = "Vertical dashed line represents the mean") -> A
# A / B

# How many are above this threshold? #
test.reads %>% filter(RA >= 7202) %>% pull(sample) %>% length()
# 51 are above #
# Below? #
test.reads %>% filter(RA < 7202) %>% pull(sample) %>% length()
# 132 are below #
quantile(test.reads$RA) %>% data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Quantile") %>%
  dplyr::rename("RA" = 2)
0.25*length(unique(reads$sample)) # You'd lose around 45 samples by a 1,000-read cutoff

# What is the distribution of reads like for the bottom quantile? #
test.reads %>% filter(RA <= 1000) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = RA)) + geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#006299") +
  theme_bw() + labs(x = "RA", y = "Count", title = "B", caption = "<1,000 RA") -> B
test.reads %>% filter(RA <= 1000) %>% pull(sample) %>% length()
test.reads %>% filter(RA <= 1000) %>% pull(RA) %>% quantile() %>%
  data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Quantile") %>%
  dplyr::rename("RA" = 2)

A / B

# Is there a relationship between read count and MOTU richness? #
reads %>% group_by(sample) %>% summarise(S = n_distinct(MOTU)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(., test.reads, by = "sample") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = RA, y = S)) + geom_point() + theme_bw() +
  stat_cor(method = "spearman", cor.coef.name = "rho") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") + labs(y = "MOTU Richness (S)")
reads %>% group_by(sample) %>% summarise(S = n_distinct(MOTU)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  pull(S) %>% mean() # Avg. richness
reads %>% group_by(sample) %>% summarise(S = n_distinct(MOTU)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  pull(S) %>% sd() # Standard deviation
reads %>% group_by(sample) %>% summarise(S = n_distinct(MOTU)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(., test.reads, by = "sample") %>%
  arrange(desc(S)) %>% View()
```

```{r Rarefaction visualization}
reads %>% group_by(sample, MOTU) %>% summarise(RA = sum(RA)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "MOTU", values_from = "RA") %>% column_to_rownames(var = "sample") %>%
  mutate(across(1:ncol(.), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) -> dDNA.comm

S = specnumber(dDNA.comm) # MOTU richness per sample #
mean(S) # Average MOTU richness #
sd(S) # With standard deviation

  rownames_to_column(var = "sample") %>%
```

```{r BLAST output comparisons to Benthos-ceviche, include = FALSE}
robust.taxonomy = taxonomy %>%
  left_join(., blast, by = c(
    intersect(colnames(taxonomy), colnames(blast)))) %>%
  filter(ASV_ID %in% reads.archive$ASV_ID) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(prey_group, sequence, seq_length,
                   accession:bit_score,
                   kingdom:species)) %>% unique() %>%
  group_by(ASV_ID) %>% unique() %>%
  mutate(db_source = paste(db_source, collapse = "/")) %>%
  ungroup()
# Combines both the taxonomy and BLAST metadata #
# It's Megazord time! #

robust.taxonomy %>% group_by(db_source) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(ASV_ID)) %>% kable()

#Plot 1
robust.taxonomy %>% group_by(db_source) %>% distinct() %>%
  count(diet_item) %>%
  mutate(db_source = case_when(
    db_source == "NCBI_nt" ~ "GenBank",
    db_source == "custom_db" ~ "Custom Reference Dataset",
    TRUE ~ "Database agreement"
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>% group_by(db_source, diet_item) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diet_item, y = n, fill = diet_item)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black", width = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~db_source) + coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#1B9E77", "#E69F00", "#D55E00", "#A6761D", "#F0E442",
               "#7570B3", "#006299", "#CC79A7", "#4D4D4D", "#E41A1C")) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#ADC7DB"),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  labs(title = "A. Sequence Variant Match Source", x = "", y = "ASV Richness") -> A
# Plot 2
reads.archive %>% left_join(., robust.taxonomy,
                            by = c("ASV_ID", "MOTU"),
                    relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    mutate(db_source = case_when(
    db_source == "NCBI_nt" ~ "GenBank",
    db_source == "custom_db" ~ "Custom Reference Dataset",
    TRUE ~ "Database agreement"
  )) %>%
    mutate(ASV_ID = paste0(MOTU, " (", "ASV", " ", c(1:nrow(.)), ")")) %>%
  group_by(ASV_ID, db_source) %>%
  summarise(RA = sum(RA)) %>%
  arrange(desc(RA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(RA = (RA/sum(RA))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_head(n = 50) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(ASV_ID, RA), y = RA*100,
             fill = db_source)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black", width = 0.75) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "C",
                     direction = -1) +

        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#ADC7DB"),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7)) +
  labs(title = "B. Highest-Read Sequence Variants",
```

## dDNA Alpha Diversity

```{r Master dataframe, include = FALSE}
reads %>%
  left_join(., (taxonomy[,-1] %>% unique()), by = "MOTU") %>%
  left_join(., metadata, by = "sample") -> df
df %>% group_by(sample) %>% mutate(RRA = RA/sum(RA)) %>% ungroup() -> df

# Presence/absence #
df %>% mutate(PA = 1) %>% dplyr::select(sample, MOTU, RRA, PA, RA,
                                        everything()) -> df
# Weighted percentage of occurrence #
df %>% group_by(sample) %>% summarise(sample.pres = sum(PA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% left_join(., df, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(wPOO = PA / sample.pres) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, MOTU, RA, RRA, PA, wPOO, everything()) %>%
  dplyr::select(-sample.pres) -> df
```

```{r Calculating alpha diversity metrics, include = FALSE}
df %>% dplyr::select(MOTU, MOTU_level) %>% unique() %>%
  group_by(MOTU_level) %>% count() %>% data.frame() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(MOTU_level = factor(MOTU_level, levels = c(
    "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species"
  ))) %>% arrange(MOTU_level) %>% kable(
    col.names = c("Parsimonious MOTU Level",
                  "MOTU Richness"))
# RRA and wPOO by group #
df %>% group_by(diet_item) %>% summarise(RRA = sum(RRA), wPOO = sum(wPOO)) %>%
  mutate(RRA = 100*(RRA/sum(RRA)), wPOO = 100*(wPOO/sum(wPOO))) %>%
  arrange(desc(RRA))
df %>% group_by(diet_item) %>% summarise(RRA = sum(RRA), wPOO = sum(wPOO)) %>%
  mutate(RRA = 100*(RRA/sum(RRA)), wPOO = 100*(wPOO/sum(wPOO))) %>%
  arrange(desc(wPOO))

df %>% filter(phylum != "Arthropoda") %>%
  group_by(diet_item) %>%
  summarise(richness = n_distinct(MOTU)) # Number of non-arthropod MOTUs
# 246 MOTUs
df %>% filter(phylum != "Arthropoda" & MOTU_level == "species") %>%
  group_by(diet_item) %>%
  summarise(richness = n_distinct(MOTU)) # Number of species-level non-arthropod MOTUs
# 182 species-level MOTUs

df %>% group_by(MOTU, phylum, diet_item) %>%
  summarise(RRA = sum(RRA)) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(RRA = 100*(RRA/sum(RRA))) %>%
  # filter(phylum != "Arthropoda") %>%
  group_by(MOTU, diet_item) %>%
  summarise(RRA = sum(RRA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% group_by(diet_item) %>%
  mutate(RRA_group_percent = 100*RRA/sum(RRA)) %>%
  arrange(desc(RRA)) -> x
df %>% group_by(MOTU, phylum, diet_item) %>%
  summarise(wPOO = sum(wPOO)) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(wPOO = 100*(wPOO/sum(wPOO))) %>%
  # filter(phylum != "Arthropoda") %>%
  group_by(MOTU, diet_item) %>%
  summarise(wPOO = sum(wPOO)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% group_by(diet_item) %>%
  mutate(wPOO_group_percent = 100*wPOO/sum(wPOO)) %>%
  arrange(desc(wPOO)) -> y
full_join(x, y, by = c("MOTU", "diet_item")) -> percent_metrics
percent_metrics %>% filter(diet_item == "Other")

df %>% group_by(diet_item) %>% na.omit() %>%
  summarise(Phyla = n_distinct(phylum),
            Classes = (n_distinct(class)),
            Orders = n_distinct(order),
            Families = n_distinct(family),
            Genera = n_distinct(genus),
            Species = n_distinct(species)) -> Table1
Table1 %>% kable() %>% kable_minimal()

# Order by presence/absence #
df %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, diet_item, MOTU, PA) %>%
  unique() %>%
  group_by(MOTU, diet_item) %>%
  summarise(PA = sum(PA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(PA)) %>%
  group_by(diet_item) %>%
  mutate(percent_occurrence = 100*(PA/length(unique(df$sample)))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-PA) -> x
df %>% dplyr::select(MOTU, diet_item, RRA, wPOO) %>%
  group_by(MOTU, diet_item) %>%
  summarise(wPOO = sum(wPOO), RRA = sum(RRA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(wPOO = (100) * (wPOO/sum(wPOO)),
         RRA = (100) * (RRA/sum(RRA))) %>%
  left_join(., x, by = c("MOTU", "diet_item")) %>%
  group_by(diet_item) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = percent_occurrence, n = 5,
            with_ties = FALSE) -> Table2
Table2 %>% kable() %>% kable_minimal()
```

## CLUSTER ANALYSIS

```{r PCoA, echo = FALSE}
# Turn off or on to apply more stringent read count #
raremax = 968 # Use the 25% quantile to cut samples
df %>% group_by(sample) %>% summarise(RA = sum(RA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(RA >= raremax) %>% distinct(sample) -> samples.over.threshold
df %>% filter(sample %in% samples.over.threshold$sample) -> ancom.df

# Analysis start #
set.seed(120396)
ancom.df %>% dplyr::select(sample, MOTU, RA) %>% # Replace with metric #
  pivot_wider(names_from = "MOTU", values_from = "RA", # Replace with metric #
              values_fn = sum) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "sample") %>%
  mutate(across(1:ncol(.), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  # rrarefy(sample = raremax) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(where(~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE) >= 2)) %>%
  decostand(method = "total") %>%
  decostand(method = "rclr") -> cluster.comm

vegdist(cluster.comm, method = "euclidean") -> dist.matrix
pamk(dist.matrix, krange = 1:10, diss = TRUE) -> PAM.out
PAM.out$nc # Optimal no. #
# hclust(dist.matrix) -> hclust.out
# plot(hclust.out)
# cutree(hclust.out, h = 20) %>% data.frame() %>%
#   rownames_to_column(var = "sample") %>%

#   mutate(cluster = case_when(
#     cluster == "1" ~ "A",
#     cluster == "2" ~ "B",
#     cluster == "3" ~ "C",
#     cluster == "4" ~ "D",
#     cluster == "5" ~ "E",
#     cluster == "6" ~ "F")) -> hclust.cluster

PAM.out$pamobject$clustering %>% data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::rename("cluster" = 2) %>%
  mutate(cluster = case_when(
    cluster == "1" ~ "A",
    cluster == "2" ~ "B",
    cluster == "3" ~ "C",
    cluster == "4" ~ "D",
    cluster == "5" ~ "E")) -> PAM.cluster
cluster.comm %>%
  vegdist(., method = "euclidean") %>% cmdscale(eig = TRUE) -> x
x$eig %>% sum() -> y
(x$eig[1] / y)*100
(x$eig[2] / y)*100

  vegdist(., method = "euclidean") %>% cmdscale(eig = FALSE) %>% data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample") %>% dplyr::rename("PCo1" = "X1",
                                                       "PCo2" = "X2") %>%
  left_join(., PAM.cluster, by = "sample") %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(x = PCo1, y = PCo2, color = cluster, shape = cluster), size = 2) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(x = PCo1, y = PCo2, color = cluster)) +
      # geom_label_repel(data = sp.scores,
      #              aes(x = V1, y = V2, label = MOTU),
      #              size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#26547c", "#CC79A7", "#1B9E77")) +
  labs(
    title = "A.",
    subtitle = bquote("PERMANOVA R"^2 ~ "= 0.34"),
    x = "PCo1 (55.6% variance explained)",
    y = "PCo2 (24.0% variance explained)", color = "PAM Cluster", shape = "PAM Cluster") +
    theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(color = "black")) -> plotA
```

## DIET REPORT COMPARISON

```{r Prey comparison}
read.data("gw_diet_items") -> gw.diet.review

taxonomic_venn <- function(rank) {
  venn_data <- list(
    "Molecular" = unique(na.omit(df[[rank]])),
    "Traditional" =
      unique(na.omit(gw.diet.review[[rank]]))
  )
  ggvenn(
    venn_data,
    fill_color = c("#26547c", "#CC79A7"),
    fill_alpha = 0.8,
    stroke_color = "white",
    stroke_size = 1.2,
    set_name_color = "#263238",
    set_name_size = 3.5,
    text_color = "#263238",
    text_size = 3.5) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(20, 30, 20, 30)
    )
}

taxonomic_venn(rank = "phylum") + labs(title = "A", subtitle = "Phylum") -> A
taxonomic_venn(rank = "class") + labs(title = "B", subtitle = "Class") -> B
taxonomic_venn(rank = "order") + labs(title = "C", subtitle = "Order") -> C
taxonomic_venn(rank = "family") + labs(title = "D", subtitle = "Family") -> D

(A | B) / (C | D) -> venn.richness

df %>% distinct(MOTU, phylum, class, order, family) %>%
  mutate(reference = "Nye et al. (this study)") %>%
  dplyr::rename(taxon = MOTU) -> x
gw.diet.review %>% distinct(taxon, phylum, class, order, family, reference) -> y
full_join(x, y) %>% group_by(reference, phylum) %>% summarise(S = n_distinct(family)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(!is.na(phylum)) %>%
  mutate(reference = factor(reference, levels = c(
    "Nerini (1984)", "Weitkamp et al. (1992)", "Darling et al. (2006)",
    "Nye et al. (this study)"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = phylum, y = S, fill = reference)) +
  coord_flip() + scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, color = "black", position = "stack") +
  labs(title = "E", x = "Phylum", y = "Family-level Richness (S)", fill = "") + theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#E69F00", "#1B9E77", "#CC79A7", "#006299")) -> E
```
